sources.title: Greenhouse and winter: what is confirmed
sources.titleZh: 温室与冬季：目前已确认的规则
sources.summary: A moderator says the greenhouse does not need heating. Snow inside is a visual issue under repair; seeds remain seasonal, but a greenhouse can grow them outside their purchase season. No winter crops are currently available.
sources.summaryZh: 官方版主说明温室不需要供暖；室内积雪是待修复的画面问题，不影响作物。种子仍按季节购买，但温室可以跨季种植；目前没有冬季作物。
sources.why: This is a usable answer, but it does not prove the current greenhouse unlock route, cost or sprinkler setup.
sources.whyZh: 这能直接帮助玩家判断温室怎么用，但不能证明当前版本的解锁路线、材料价格或洒水器接法。
sources.risk: The reply does not confirm the unlock route, cost or sprinkler setup; do not fill those gaps from older guides.
sources.riskZh: 这条答复没有确认解锁路线、材料价格或洒水器接法；不要用旧攻略替它补全这些空白。

answer.title: Greenhouse: winter checks, materials and unlock limits
answer.titleZh: 温室：冬季使用、材料准备与解锁边界
answer.summary: Already have a greenhouse? The August 16 moderator reply says no greenhouse heating is needed, indoor snow is visual, and seasonal seed buying differs from out-of-season greenhouse planting. If you are planning one instead, open the retained material list before the unverified unlock notes.
answer.summaryZh: 已有温室时，8月16日版主答复说明无需供暖、积雪是画面问题，并区分按季节买种子与温室内跨季种植。还在准备建温室时，先看保留的材料清单，再看尚未确认的解锁说明。
answer.unresolved: The material list is .842 shop configuration, not a full price or verified current purchase route. A dated no-heating answer is not a promise that plants cannot disappear; check watering, weeds and plantation warnings.
answer.unresolvedZh: 材料来自.842商店配置，不是完整报价或已实测的当前购买路线。不需供暖的旧答复也不保证作物不会消失，仍要查浇水、杂草与田块警告。
answer.historyNote: Keep the August 19 scan separate from the August 16 replies #3, #4, #7 and #9. The thread gives winter-use guidance without a game-build number. November 2022 unlock notes do not establish an Early Access vendor; the existing retained shop record supplies planning materials, not runtime availability.
answer.historyNoteZh: 8月19日是收录日期，原答复为8月16日 #3、#4、#7、#9，未注明游戏版本。2022年11月解锁资料不能证明抢先体验商人；现有商店记录只提供材料准备，不证明当前可购买。
answer.searchTags: greenhouse winter heating snow seeds materials unlock 温室 冬季 加热 积雪 种子 材料 解锁

links.label: Already built: winter checks
links.labelZh: 已有温室：冬季使用检查

sources.title: How to remove an empty crop square
sources.summary: There is no tool to remove a tilled square manually. Leave it empty, unseeded and unwatered; after several dry days it can disappear on its own. Rain slows that recovery.
sources.summaryZh: 当前没有手动移除农田格的工具。让它保持空白、不播种、不浇水，经过几个干燥日后会自然消失；下雨会拖慢这个过程。
sources.why: The exact number of days is still not official, so the guide keeps the player estimate separate from the supported action.
sources.whyZh: 官方没有给出精确天数，所以页面只采用可执行的处理方式，不把玩家估计的天数写成定论。
sources.risk: The recovery time is not a confirmed day count, and rain or a patch may change the observed timing.
sources.riskZh: 恢复时间没有确认的具体天数；下雨或后续补丁可能改变玩家观察到的时长。

answer.title: Remove a crop plot with the Hoe
answer.summary: Equip the Hoe and use its plantation-removal action on the plot you want to remove. The 14 September update 0.8.10.868 added this option; each removal costs 2 Nature Skill Points.
answer.summaryZh: 装备锄头，对准准备移除的田块，使用移除种植地的操作。9月14日的0.8.10.868更新加入此功能，每次扣2点自然技能点。
answer.unresolved: The dry-day workaround below is a July reply, not the only removal method after that update. If you want to keep the crop, follow planting and daily care rather than removing its plot.
answer.unresolvedZh: 下方等待干燥日的办法来自7月旧回复，不是该更新后唯一的移除方法。想保留作物时，应查看种植与日常照料，而不是移除田块。
answer.historyNote: The 20 August collection recorded a 31 July moderator reply about empty plots drying away. It predates Hoe removal. That historical advice is not a watering schedule for planted crops.
answer.historyNoteZh: 8月20日的收录记录保存了7月31日版主关于空田自然消失的答复，早于锄头移除功能。旧等待办法不能当作已种作物的浇水计划。
answer.searchTags: farming hoe remove empty crop plot plantation dry days 锄头 移除 农田格 种植地

links.label: Keep a crop: planting and daily care
links.labelZh: 保留作物：种植与日常照料

sources.title: Why eggs are marked Infertile
sources.summary: The official troubleshooting answer points to breeding age and complete needs or satisfaction as prerequisites. A player also reported a linked-count recovery after moving a rooster out and back, but that workaround remains a single report.
sources.summaryZh: 官方排查答复指出，繁殖需要达到繁殖年龄，并满足全部需求与满意度。玩家还报告过迁出再迁回公鸡后恢复受精，但这个 workaround 仍只是单人报告。
sources.why: The page separates the official prerequisites from the unverified relocation workaround instead of presenting one player fix as a universal rule.
sources.whyZh: 页面把官方前置条件和单人报告的迁舍 workaround 分开，避免把一个玩家的修复方法说成通用机制。
sources.risk: The relocation workaround is a single player report and may not reproduce on every coop or build.
sources.riskZh: 迁舍 workaround 只是单人报告，未必能在每个鸡舍或版本复现。
sources.sourceLabelZh: 官方前置条件 + 玩家线索

answer.title: Infertile eggs: check breeding prerequisites, not egg size
answer.titleZh: 鸡蛋显示未受精：先查繁殖条件，别与大鸡蛋混淆
answer.summary: For an Infertile egg, first check breeding age and all needs and satisfaction, as the moderator recommends. This is a breeding question; a missing Large Egg for Gigi belongs to the separate egg-size route.
answer.summaryZh: 鸡蛋显示 Infertile（未受精）时，按版主答复先查繁殖年龄、全部需求与满意度。这是繁殖问题；Gigi 任务迟迟不出大鸡蛋，应走另一条尺寸与掉落排查。
answer.unresolved: No exact breeding age, success rate or recovery deadline is given. A rooster relocation helped one player with an inconsistent coop count; it is not a universal next-day fix.
answer.unresolvedZh: 原答复没有具体繁殖年龄、成功概率或恢复天数。迁舍只帮助过一名报告鸡舍计数异常的玩家，不是保证第二天恢复的通用修复法。
answer.historyNote: The original August 17 record is preserved. Reply #1 is the moderator's prerequisite check. Reply #2 is Britto's relocation report; its initial and follow-up flock descriptions differ, so it does not establish a capacity rule or controlled recovery test. No game build is stated.
answer.historyNoteZh: 保留8月17日原收录。#1是版主前置条件，#2是Britto的迁舍报告；首帖与后续的鸡群描述不一致，不能据此推出鸡舍容量规则或当作受控复现。原帖未注明游戏版本。
answer.evidenceLabel: August 17 moderator reply and separate player follow-up
answer.evidenceLabelZh: 8月17日版主答复与独立标注的玩家后续
answer.searchTags: infertile fertile eggs breeding age satisfaction rooster chicken 未受精 受精蛋 繁殖年龄 公鸡 满意度

links.label: Need a Large Egg for Gigi instead?

sources.title: Animal seller shop is locked
sources.summary: The official answer says a purple-heart relationship can trigger a shop embargo, and only the first gift of the day changes the relationship. A player reported recovering access with plant gifts; the exact favourite list still needs separate testing.
sources.summaryZh: 官方答复说明，紫心关系可能触发商店封锁，而且每天只有第一份礼物影响关系。玩家报告用植物类礼物恢复入口，但具体喜好表仍需分别验证。
sources.why: This turns a vague NPC problem into a clear first check without inventing a universal best gift.
sources.whyZh: 它把“商店打不开”变成了明确的第一步排查，同时没有凭空编造通用的最佳礼物。
sources.risk: The plant-gift recovery is a player report, not a universal favourite list or guaranteed fix.
sources.riskZh: 植物礼物恢复商店只是玩家报告，不是通用喜好表，也不是保证有效的修复。
sources.sourceLabelZh: 官方机制 + 玩家恢复报告

answer.title: Animal shop locked? Check heart colour before gifting again
answer.titleZh: 动物商店打不开？先看心形颜色，别连续刷礼物
answer.summary: For Angela or Malcolm's missing purchase tab, check whether the hearts are purple, not red. The moderator connects purple hearts with a shop embargo, and says only the first gift of a day improves the relationship. Do not treat more purple hearts as progress.
answer.summaryZh: Angela 或 Malcolm 的购买选项消失时，先看心形是紫色还是红色。版主把紫心与商店拒售联系起来，并说明每天只有第一份礼物能提升关系；紫心变多不是好感提升，别靠同一天连续送礼来刷关系。
answer.unresolved: No favourite item or recovery deadline is confirmed here. Plant gifts restored access for one player, not every NPC. If the shop is still unavailable, record the NPC, heart colour, working context and your game version.
answer.unresolvedZh: 这里没有已确认的万能礼物或恢复天数。植物礼物恢复商店只是一名玩家的报告；仍无法购买时，记下NPC、心形颜色、是否在工作和游戏版本。
answer.historyNote: The August 19 scan is retained. Moderator replies #1 and #3 were posted August 15; the plant-gift recovery is Mancer's August 16 report #4. The thread names no game build, and does not establish a complete gift list, stock rule or relationship reward table.
answer.historyNoteZh: 保留8月19日收录。版主#1、#3发表于8月15日；植物礼物恢复来自Mancer的8月16日#4。原帖未注明游戏版本，也没有证明完整喜好表、补货规则或关系奖励表。
answer.evidenceLabelZh: 8月15日版主排查答复（未注明版本）
answer.searchTags: animal shop locked purchase tab missing Angela Malcolm purple hearts gifts embargo 动物商店 打不开 购买选项 紫心 红心 送礼 拒售

sources.title: NPC relationship recovery is still an open lead
sources.titleZh: NPC 关系恢复仍是待验证线索
sources.summary: A current player question asks how to recover an NPC relationship after gifts stopped helping and the NPC stopped talking. The official shop-embargo reply is useful context, but the current question has no universal gift list or confirmed recovery route.
sources.summaryZh: 当前玩家问题在追问：送礼不再生效、NPC 不愿对话后，关系该怎么恢复。官方关于商店封锁的答复可以提供背景，但这条新问题没有通用礼物表，也没有确认的恢复路线。
sources.why: It points to a real player pain point without turning one player's gift experiment into a rule. A build, NPC name and before/after relationship screenshot would make it testable.
sources.whyZh: 它指向真实的玩家痛点，但没有把一个玩家的送礼尝试写成规则。补充版本、NPC 名称和关系变化前后截图后，才适合复测。
sources.risk: Do not assume one plant gift, favourite list or number of days works for every NPC. The current post has no official resolution.
sources.riskZh: 不要假设某种植物礼物、喜好表或天数对所有 NPC 都有效；当前帖子还没有官方解决方案。
sources.sourceLabelZh: 当前玩家问题 + 官方背景

answer.title: Charcoal: known method, missing controls and yield
answer.titleZh: 木炭：已知制作方向，具体操作与产量待核实
answer.summary: Community staff says Charcoal comes from burning wood rather than buying it. Use the existing guide for the answer and its source; the reply does not give exact controls, timing or output.
answer.summaryZh: 社区工作人员说明木炭由燃烧木材获得，不是去商店购买。先看现有指南的答复与出处；原回复没有给出精确按键、计时或产量。
answer.unresolved: Do not turn the older Alpha yield or fire-spread discussion into current instructions. The September staff reply does not verify those details or name a gameplay build.
answer.unresolvedZh: 不要把旧 Alpha 的产量或火势蔓延讨论当成当前操作步骤。9 月的工作人员答复没有确认这些细节，也未注明游戏版本。
answer.historyNote: The August record below was a title-only research lead. The separately linked September staff answer now supplies the method direction; exact reproduction is still missing.
answer.historyNoteZh: 下方 8 月记录原本只是标题级研究线索；另行列出的 9 月工作人员答复已补上制作方向，精确复现仍未完成。
answer.searchTags: materials charcoal wood 木炭 木材 制作

sources.title: A current charcoal lead, but no public steps yet
sources.titleZh: 当前有木炭线索，但公开步骤还不完整
sources.summary: A current Steam community item says a player figured out how to make charcoal, but its public preview does not show the method. An older Alpha discussion described burning wood or logs, so it is useful as a research lead only.
sources.summaryZh: 当前 Steam 社区里有玩家表示自己找到了制作木炭的方法，但公开预览没有给出步骤。更早的 Alpha 讨论提到燃烧木材或原木，因此目前只能把它当作研究线索。
sources.why: Players looking for charcoal now have a place to compare new reports and submit a screenshot or clip. The old thread also tells us what must be re-tested, without pretending its recipe is current.
sources.whyZh: 正在找木炭的玩家有了集中比对新报告、提交截图或视频的位置。旧帖可以提示复测方向，但不能把旧配方当成当前答案。
sources.risk: The Alpha method, yield and fire behaviour may be obsolete. Do not treat burning logs, an 8-charcoal yield or fire-spread warnings as current instructions.
sources.riskZh: Alpha 版本的方法、产量和火焰行为可能已经过时。不要把燃烧原木、8 个木炭产量或火势蔓延提醒当成当前操作说明。
sources.sourceLabel: Current player lead + Historical Alpha thread
sources.sourceLabelZh: 当前玩家线索 + 历史 Alpha 帖

sources.title: Can extra roosters be sold?
sources.summary: A current player is asking whether Early Access has a way to sell extra roosters or chickens after hatching too many males. The site's animal record already carries an official answer that live-animal sales are not implemented, but the direct source URL is not retained in this card; the new question is a prompt to recheck for a later change.
sources.summaryZh: 当前玩家在询问：孵出太多公鸡后，Early Access 是否有出售多余公鸡或鸡的办法。本站动物记录已有官方答复称活体出售尚未实装，但这张卡没有保留原帖直链；新问题适合用来监测后续版本是否变化。
sources.why: It connects a live player question to the existing chicken selling answer instead of leaving the player at an isolated discussion index.
sources.whyZh: 它把当前玩家问题接到已有的养鸡出售答案，而不是让玩家停在一个孤立的讨论区首页。
sources.risk: The official answer in the animal record also lacks a retained direct URL. Recheck the current build before treating the sale status as unchanged.
sources.riskZh: 动物记录里的官方答复同样没有保留原帖直链；把出售状态当作仍未变化前，应该重新核对当前版本。
sources.sourceLabel: Open player question + existing animal record
sources.sourceLabelZh: 待验证玩家问题 + 现有动物记录

answer.title: Extra roosters: the recorded meat-sale route
answer.titleZh: 多余的公鸡：先留种，再按记录处理卖肉
answer.summary: Keep any birds you want for breeding. For a surplus chicken, the moderator's route is to put it on the ground, use an axe or pickaxe, then sell the meat. Processing removes that bird; check the steps before choosing it.
answer.summaryZh: 先留好繁殖用的鸡。对确实多余的鸡，版主给出的路线是放到地上，用斧头或镐处理，再卖肉；处理会失去这只鸡，选定前先看步骤。
answer.unresolved: The reply does not explicitly establish live-animal sale support. No build is stated; poultry instructions do not establish how cows or goats are sold. No fixed payout or egg-versus-meat profit is guaranteed.
answer.unresolvedZh: 原答复没有明确确认活体出售功能，也未注明版本；鸡的处理方式不能推广到牛或山羊，不保证固定售价或比留鸡卖蛋更赚钱。
answer.historyNote: The August 21 scan is retained below. Its old summary overstated the reply as proof that live sales were unimplemented. Replies #1, #3 and #6 in the recovered August 2–3 thread support the poultry meat route, not that blanket denial.
answer.historyNoteZh: 保留下方8月21日收录记录。旧摘要把答复扩大成了“活体出售未实装”的证明；本次找到8月2–3日原帖 #1、#3、#6，支持的是鸡的处理卖肉路线，而非这个笼统结论。
answer.evidenceLabelZh: 8月2–3日版主原答复（未注明版本）
answer.searchTags: chicken rooster surplus sell meat live sale poultry 多余公鸡 卖鸡 卖肉 活体出售

sources.title: Missing seed
sources.summary: A current discussion is asking why a seed is unavailable or missing. It is a lead for checking season, shop schedule, inventory and the exact seed name, not proof of a universal bug.
sources.summaryZh: 当前讨论区有人询问种子不可用或消失的原因。它适合作为选题线索，下一步要核对季节、商店营业、背包和种子名称，不能直接当成通用 bug。
sources.why: A useful report needs the missing seed name, season, shop and a screenshot of the inventory or purchase screen.
sources.whyZh: 要把它变成可解决的问题，需要补充种子名称、季节、商店状态，以及背包或购买界面截图。
sources.risk: A missing seed may be seasonal, shop-related or inventory-related; this card does not establish a bug.
sources.riskZh: 种子不见可能与季节、商店或背包有关；这张卡不能证明存在通用 bug。

answer.title: Missing seed: check purchase, inventory or planted plot
answer.titleZh: 种子不见了：先区分购买、背包与田块
answer.summary: Choose where the seed is missing. For a shop listing, open the seed-store filter and start with Any season. For a purchased item, record the name and inventory screen. For a planted seed, check the daily report and plantation warning before replanting.
answer.summaryZh: 先分清在哪一步缺失：商店找不到时打开种子商店筛选，先用不限季节查名称；已买的种子找不到时保留名称与背包画面；种下后消失时先看日终报告和田块警告，再决定补种。
answer.unresolved: The old report names no seed or exact thread, so its cause remains unknown. Listing season is not growing season; configuration entries are not guaranteed current stock. These checks are not an inventory-recovery promise.
answer.unresolvedZh: 旧收录没有具体种子名和原帖直链，原因仍未知。商品季节不等于种植季节，配置条目不保证当前有货；这条检查路径也不承诺找回背包物品。
answer.historyNote: The August 20 scan remains an unresolved lead. The links below provide existing lookup and warning-based checks, not proof that a particular player's seed was found. The .868 official source applies to plantation warnings, not shop stock or inventory recovery.
answer.historyNoteZh: 8月20日原始收录继续作为未解决线索保留。这里只接入已有查询和警告排查，不表示已找到某位玩家的种子。.868官方来源针对田块警告，不证明商店库存或背包恢复。
answer.searchTags: missing seeds shop inventory planted lost buy seed season 种子不见 找不到种子 商店 背包 田块

answer.title: Coal, Charcoal or Zirconite? Start with the item name
answer.titleZh: 煤、木炭还是锆矿？先对照物品名称
